Good morning Ms Deepa,

We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience and truly appreciate your understanding.

We have checked with the team, and unfortunately, there are currently some issues with the utility connections in the apartment. As we genuinely want to ensure that everything is properly prepared and working before your arrival, we are unable to proceed with the reservation starting from 1st September at this time.

Your comfort and experience are very important to us, and we do not want to confirm the booking until all the necessary utility connections are fully operational and the apartment is ready for a comfortable stay.

We sincerely regret any inconvenience this may cause and appreciate your patience and understanding. We will be happy to assist you once the unit is fully prepared and ready for occupancy.

Thank you again for your kind understanding.
